name: workbench-dismiss-scrim
title: Move workbench dismiss to outside-area click
description: Remove the center-panel click-to-dismiss; only clicks outside the workbench area hide it via WorkbenchOuterDismiss.
creator: M0e_N00b
notes: Follow-up from the workbench UX batch. DONE 2026-10-02 in 856356a (build-windows-debug.ps1 BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 172 unit tests). Removed the center panel root click-to-dismiss and the whole now-dead onDismissWorkbench callback chain (ImmersiveCenterContentPanel -> RecommendationPanel -> RecommendationContent -> CenterContentWorkspace) plus the Activity call site, so WorkbenchOuterDismiss is the single outside-area dismiss owner -- matching the rule already stated at SpatialVideoSampleActivity.onStagePrimaryAction(). Verified in code rather than assumed: suppressOuterDismissUntilMs is armed only by openSearchCanvas() and its handler only prevents dismissal (no first-click misfire); MediaStage still only reveals transport while the Workbench is visible; dismissWorkbenchFromCenterContent stays referenced by the outer-dismiss listener. STILL OPEN (device): confirm the WorkbenchOuterDismiss hit geometry fully covers the area outside the Workbench and does not block rail/transport/nav/input-method raycasts. That geometry is authored in Composition.glxf and was not touched.
